body.heading: Where in the world is Liberia?
paragraphs: Liberia is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Liberia is Monrovia.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Liberia is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Liberia is the Liberian dollar.

body.heading: How big is Liberia?
paragraphs: Liberia covers about 111,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Ghana.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Sapo protects one of West Africa's last great rainforests, home to forest elephants, pygmy hippos and chimpanzees beneath enormous trees.
Robertsport is a laid-back surf town where rolling Atlantic waves meet golden sand — Liberia's favourite beach escape, dotted with old seaside houses.

body.heading: Think and talk

2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
